description: Verification and feature badge standards for awesome-free-stack resources

badges.name: Tested
badges.description: Resource has been personally tested and confirmed working by a maintainer.
criteria: Maintainer signed up and successfully used the free tier
Free tier limits confirmed accurate
No credit card requirement verified (where claimed)
Region restrictions confirmed
Documentation accuracy spot-checked
badges.expiry_action: Re-test or downgrade to Community Verified

badges.name: Community Verified
badges.description: Reported and confirmed by multiple community members, not yet tested by a maintainer.
criteria: At least 3 independent community reports confirming free tier
No conflicting reports of broken or degraded free tier
Entry has been in the repository for at least 30 days
No maintainer bandwidth to personally test (will be promoted to Tested upon verification)
badges.expiry_action: Downgrade to Unverified if not re-confirmed

badges.name: Unverified
badges.description: Submitted but not yet tested or confirmed by anyone.
criteria: Submitted via pull request but not yet reviewed
No maintainer or community confirmation
Entry is accepted provisionally
Displayed lower in rankings until verified
badges.expiry_action: Auto-downgrade to warning status if not verified within 90 days

badges.name: Deprecated
badges.description: Resource is no longer free, free tier removed, or service shut down.
criteria: Free tier has been removed or reduced to unusable levels
Service has been shut down or acquired
Open-source project has been archived by owner
Entry moved to deprecated/ folder after marking
badges.expiry_action: Move to deprecated/ folder after 30 days of marking

badges.name: Archived
badges.description: Entry has been moved to the archive. Referenced for historical purposes only.
criteria: Previously marked as Deprecated for at least 30 days
No possibility of free tier returning
Entry moved to deprecated/archived.md
Original file removed from its category folder

badges.name: Student Friendly
badges.description: Offers special benefits or enhanced free tier for verified students.
criteria: Verified student email unlocks additional features or quota
Student tier is free (not a discounted paid plan)
Benefits exceed the regular free tier significantly
Verification method is documented (edu email, ISIC, SheerID)

badges.name: India Friendly
badges.description: Works well for users in India with local payment support, no restrictions, or India-specific benefits.
criteria: Full service available in India (no VPN required)
Accepts Indian credit/debit cards or UPI/NetBanking
No India-specific throttling or feature restrictions
Pricing in INR or reasonable forex rates
Data residency options in India (preferred but not required)

badges.name: Top Rated
badges.description: Among the highest-rated resources in its category (overall score ≥ 4.5).
criteria: Overall rating score >= 4.5 (Elite tier)
Minimum of 5 individual ratings submitted
No open issues about broken free tier
Re-calculated quarterly

badges.name: No Card Required
badges.description: No credit card is required to sign up and start using the free tier.
criteria: Sign-up process completed without credit card information
Free tier accessible immediately after email verification
No hidden card requirement after trial period
Confirmed by maintainer test

badges.name: Global
badges.description: Available worldwide with no region restrictions or sanctions-related blocks.
criteria: No country-level restrictions on sign-up
No US, EU, or UN sanctions blocking access
Service can be used from any country without VPN
Content delivery via global CDN or multi-region hosting
